verdicts.title: Scattering theory on Riemann surfaces I: Schiffer operators, cohomology, and index theorems
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We consider a compact Riemann surface $\mathscr{R}$ with a complex of non-intersecting Jordan curves, whose complement is a pair of Riemann surfaces with boundary, each of which may be possibly disconnected. We investigate conformally invariant integral operators of Schiffer, which act on $L^{2}$ anti-holomorphic one-forms on one of these surfaces with boundary and produce holomorphic one-forms on the disjoint union. verdicts.title: Bases for Riemann--Roch spaces of linearized function fields with applications to generalized algebraic geometry codes
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper, we determine explicit bases for Riemann--Roch spaces of linearized function fields, and we give a lower bound for the minimum distance of generalized algebraic geometry codes. As a consequence, we construct generalized algebraic geometry codes with good parameters.
